description.en: Provisions and controls Bluetooth SIG mesh lighting nodes directly, with no cloud and no relay app in between.

label.en: Colour temperature values this app sends

hint.en: The lowest Light CTL Temperature value this app will send, at the warm end of the slider. A bulb that follows the specification reads it as kelvin; other bulbs ignore the numbers and simply stretch their whole output across whatever range they are given, which is why this starts at the full 800-20000 span the specification allows. Filled in from the bulb itself when it answers Light CTL Temperature Range Get. Narrow the range only if your bulb misbehaves at the extremes.

The highest Light CTL Temperature value this app will send, at the cold end of the slider. Must be above the lowest value. A bulb that follows the specification reads it as kelvin; other bulbs ignore the numbers and simply stretch their whole output across whatever range they are given, which is why this starts at the full 800-20000 span the specification allows. Filled in from the bulb itself when it answers Light CTL Temperature Range Get. Narrow the range only if your bulb misbehaves at the extremes.
